description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 06/2019, Sticker and sticker Management System
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory amendments to the Excise Ordinance, specifically modifying rules related to sticker requirements for excisable articles. It contains legal/regulatory provisions (amending rules under an existing ordinance) and does not focus on government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the Minister of Finance is incidental to the regulatory action being taken.
